headline: Sensex and Nifty rally as market opens higher supported by Reliance earnings and lower crude prices.

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Reliance earnings and lower crude oil prices powered Sensex to near a two-month high.
GIFT Nifty signaled a gap-up open as Sensex zoomed over 600 points.
Crude oil prices fell as peace talk hopes outweighed concerns over attacks.
Strong market momentum driven by gains in major midcap and largecap stocks.
whatHappening: Nifty traded over the 23,200 mark while Sensex approached the 23,600 level.
Asian Paints and Coal India reached their last day to buy for upcoming dividend payouts.
Trident surged 10% and Marico gained 6% among major stock movers.
Welspun Living and Delhivery posted Q2 FY27 results today.
summary: Indian equities extended their winning run with Sensex zooming 600 points and Nifty approaching 23,600. Strong earnings from Reliance along with falling crude oil prices fueled positive market sentiment. Stock-specific action remained high due to dividend deadlines and earnings announcements.
